rationale_code: The tool reads Figma file or node data from the fixed Figma API using the user's configured or per-request Figma credentials and returns the serialized design data to the agent, so it can expose non-public SaaS data (`SECRET`). The returned serialized Figma data includes design text, layer/node name

The tool fetches image/render data for a Figma file through the authenticated Figma API and returns derived non-public information such as downloaded file paths and image dimensions, so it can expose non-public SaaS data (`SECRET`).
